# 2026-10-03 — Returns and Exceptions

> Status: reviewed. Participants: Maya, Jo. Evidence: three cross-branch questions and one incomplete accessory check.

## Observations

Borrowers asked whether tools could be returned at another branch. None was processed there, and the [posted notice](../sources/desk-rules.txt) only describes check-in at the original desk. A volunteer also found a missing bit but did not know which form should receive the first note.

## No decision

Do not infer a cross-branch transfer rule or a damage fee. Put the tool aside and record the observation. These are [open questions](../kb/returns-and-exceptions.md#open-questions).
